prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings
head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via the commit history of addGuests.handler.ts (first commit baa9045af7, 'feat: ability to add guests via app.cal.com/bookings (#14740)'). PR headRefOid equals the benchmark head and the merged handler is byte-identical to the benchmark head. The repo calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy.

tps.bug: addGuests does not check the booking status, so guests can be added to cancelled or rejected bookings, which updates calendars and emails invitations for events that no longer exist.
tps.evidenciaOpus: addGuestsHandler loads the booking by id alone (addGuests.handler.ts:26-41) and checks only who the caller is, never booking.status. The handler then adds attendees, updates the calendar event and sends guest emails, so this also runs for CANCELLED or REJECTED bookings when the endpoint is called directly.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The new handler fetches bookings solely by ID without checking status (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:26), then persists guests and invokes calendar updates and emails (:92, :165, :168). Even when cancellation leaves no calendar references, the calendar method simply returns (packages/core/EventManager.ts:597), allowing scheduled-event invitations to be sent for the cancelled booking (packages/emails/email-manager.ts:542).
